patthana23.58:3.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho ajjhattārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. sanidassana
patthana23.58:4.1: sappaṭighaṃ na bahiddhārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho bahiddhārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. avigate tīṇi.
patthana23.58:5.1: (sahajātavārampi paccayavārampi saṃsaṭṭhavārampi sampayuttavārampi pañhāvārampi vitthāretabbaṃ.) paccanīyānuloma tikatika paṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
